subject: rmarkdown on shiny-server: cannot find data

messages.author: b7af2ea70efc5630
messages.subject: rmarkdown on shiny-server: cannot find data
parts:
I have an rmarkdown page containing a shiny app and html. The app contains a downloadHandler function linking to an .xlsx data table in the app folder. The same document indexed in html below in the rmarkdown document returns the "Not found" page. 

The file path is the same. I have also tried changing the table position to a www folder , but I get the same outcome.


My HTML code:

<a href="search/data/Supplemental_File_1.xlsx" download="Supplemental_File_1.xslx">Supplemental File 1 </a>
My shinyApp object:
output$downloadTags=downloadHandler(filename = "Supplemental_File.xlsx",
                                           content = function(file) {file.copy("search/data/Supplemental_File_1.xlsx",file)},
                                          contentType = "text/csv")

messages.author: b7af2ea70efc5630
messages.subject: Re: rmarkdown on shiny-server: cannot find data
parts:
Solved: the www folder (or any other folder in shiny-server) does not have ftp characteristics and thus is not found on the ftp default path when a browser tries accessing the file.

I am not clear how the downloadHandler object goes around this problem, but, when calling from an html link without a shiny front-end, the only solution seems to host the file in a ftp-server directory within your own server.
